answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using proof of space-time. A node ascends an admission terrace by committing cryptographic plots to physical storage. When peers whisper challenge queries, it must prove continuous storage occupancy within strict deadlines. Adversaries must commit scarce non-volatile drive capacity per identity rather than spawning a river of virtual bots. However, continuous auditing causes severe drive wear and favors entities with surplus enterprise hardware.
